page.overview:
What is Memory?

A Memory, also known as Memory Disc or Memory Drive, is an item introduced in the Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon games in Generation VII. It is used to help Silvally and its Multi-Attack move change into any one of the 18 types through its RKS System Ability. It works in the same way than Arceus' Plates but doesn't give type-boosting bonus. They closely resemble TM Discs.
